body: Can still replicate on `v4.4.1.stable` and `v4.5.beta2`. The code suggests that the image format indicates it is in sRGB, while in fact it isn't. Not sure if this is an issue with the texture itself, so needs more investigation.

I can still reproduce this on 4.7.rc dc7d8ff6d in all renderers, even in 3D: Note that the texture included in the first post is uncompressed in VRAM, at least on desktop: `file` information: ``` QEbvwX_0.ktx2: Khronos KTX2 texture, 1024 x 1024, 11 mipmaps, BasisLZ ``` > Godot v4.7.rc (dc7d8ff6d) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 595.71.05) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) @acazuc @nikitalita Any ideas about this?
